page_title: NAP 2-1 ACM | Napoli v AC Milan 30/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
90+1' Half-chance! Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) plays a pass into the box, but Alex Meret reacts well to snuff out the attack.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from AC Milan comes to nothing.
87' Wasted opportunity! Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
85' Antonio Conte decides to make a substitution. David Neres will be replaced by Cyril Ngonge (Napoli).
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) comes onto the pitch for Romelu Lukaku.
85' The substitution has been made. Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) has replaced Matteo Politano.
84' 2 - 1 Luka Jovic (AC Milan) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the middle of the net.
82' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
81' Problems for Antonio Conte as Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Juan Jesus replaces him.
80' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
79' Sergio Conceicao has decided to make a change. Luka Jovic (AC Milan) replaces Christian Pulisic.
79' We are about to witness a substitution. Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) is replacing Kyle Walker.
79' A dangerous attempt from Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) was aimed towards the roof of the net, but Alex Meret pulls off a superb save and stops this one.
78' That's unlucky! Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
76' Although Antonio Conte (Napoli) is just on the bench, Simone Sozza has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
76' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is adjudged offside.
75' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) picks up a long through ball, but Mike Maignan deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
74' The ball is cleared after Rafael Leao (AC Milan) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
71' Sergio Conceicao (AC Milan) gets a yellow card, off the field.

69' Alex Meret anticipates the direction of the penalty by Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan). He attempted to put the ball into the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
69' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
69' Simone Sozza interrupts the game. One of the players from Napoli won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Penalty awarded! AC Milan will take a penalty kick.
68' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
67' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is caught offside!
65' The referee signals a substitution. Philip Billing (Napoli) is brought on as a substitute for Frank Anguissa.

64' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom right corner is, however, superbly saved by Alex Meret!
63' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
61' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
61' Matteo Politano (Napoli) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
59' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
57' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Rafael Leao (AC Milan), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
56' A fine solo run by Rafael Leao (AC Milan) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies well wide of the right post.
55' Here is a change. Tammy Abraham is going off and Sergio Conceicao gives the last tactical orders to Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan).
55' Joao Felix comes off the pitch to be replaced by Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan).
52' A pass by Billy Gilmour (Napoli) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

50' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Simone Sozza with no other option than to blow for a foul. Napoli have been awarded a free kick.

37' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
35' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
34' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. AC Milan have been awarded a corner kick.
32' David Neres (Napoli) meets a perfect cross on the edge of the box and rips a shot that goes well wide of the right post.
31' A pass by Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
29' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 3:0.

24' Billy Gilmour (Napoli) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
23' Matteo Politano (Napoli) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
19' 2 - 0 Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets into the bottom right corner.
18' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.

17' AC Milan slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
16' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
15' The ball goes out for a corner. Napoli can continue in their attacking effort.
15' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
14' Simone Sozza has a clear sight and sees a foul from Billy Gilmour (Napoli). AC Milan are awarded the free kick.
13' The ball is behind the sideline. Mathias Olivera (Napoli) takes a throw-in.
12' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
11' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post.
9' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Alex Meret comes off his line to intercept.
7' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
7' David Neres (Napoli) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
6' A player from AC Milan takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Napoli will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
4' The AC Milan players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
